Looking at the render and the carried-over reflection, I've studied the contact sheet. The scene is geometrically mature (open frame, exploded radix-4 BU, exploded heatsink, 8 distinct banks/lanes, separate reduction members — all legible). The remaining work is **fidelity/self-consistency**: the scene still carries the *contradictions* the reproduce loop flagged (a buggy additive bank function that its own notes say collides; an exploded datapath showing the *naive* 3 multipliers while the committed spec says the optimized count is 2; two conflicting twiddle-ROM address functions; contradictory FSM lists). I'll reconcile the geometry and annotations to the committed values.
